headline: A 1995 executive order links federal government purchasing to community right-to-know rules about chemical releases.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order connects how the federal government buys goods and services with community right-to-know rules. Those rules generally require public reporting of toxic chemicals released by facilities. No summary was provided, so the exact requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They may face chemical release reporting expectations tied to their federal contracts.
They may gain more public information about chemicals released in their communities.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 8, 1995; specific effective dates were not provided.
